ex.en: The fingers move fast on the keyboard.
ex.zh: 手指在鍵盤上飛快地移動。

ex.en: The Swiss keyboard doesn't have a ß.
ex.zh: 瑞士的鍵盤沒有「ß」這個符號。

keyboard.en: a set of keys that you press to type on a computer

ex.en: "Is this an electronic keyboard?" "It's a synthesizer."
ex.zh: “這是電子琴嗎？”“這是合成器。”

ex.en: He creates melodies on his keyboard.
ex.zh: 他用電子琴創作旋律。

keyboard.en: a musical instrument with keys that you press, like a piano

ex.en: Mary keeps her laptop with her at all times.
ex.zh: 瑪麗隨時把筆電帶在身邊。

ex.en: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
ex.zh: 收據留著，以防需要退款。

keep.en: to have something and not give it away or lose it

ex.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
ex.zh: 抱歉讓你久等了。

ex.en: I was kept waiting for nearly half an hour.
ex.zh: 我等了將近半小時。

keep.en: to make someone or something stay in a certain state

ex.en: Keep going straight.
ex.zh: 繼續直走。

ex.en: He keeps calling me.
ex.zh: 他一直打電話給我。

keep.en: to continue doing something without stopping

ex.en: You should keep your promise.
ex.zh: 你應該遵守承諾。

ex.en: She always keeps her word.
ex.zh: 她總是說到做到。

keep.en: to do what you said you would do

ex.en: Let's keep in touch.
ex.zh: 我們保持聯絡吧。

ex.en: Keep in touch after you graduate.
ex.zh: 畢業後要保持聯絡喔。

keep.en: to continue to talk or write to someone

ex.en: I'm looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
ex.zh: 我在找鑰匙，你有看到嗎？

ex.en: Would you help me look for my keys?
ex.zh: 你能幫我找鑰匙嗎？

ex.en: It seems that I have lost my keys.
ex.zh: 我好像把鑰匙弄丟了。

key.en: a small metal object used to open or close a lock

ex.en: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.
ex.zh: 如你所知，毅力是成功的關鍵。

ex.en: This letter is the only key to the mystery.
ex.zh: 這封信是解開謎團的唯一線索。

key.en: the most important thing that helps you achieve something

ex.en: She plays a key role in the project.
ex.zh: 她在這個專案中扮演關鍵角色。

ex.en: Communication is a key skill for managers.
ex.zh: 溝通是主管的關鍵能力。

ex.en: Press any key to continue.
ex.zh: 按任意鍵繼續。

ex.en: The Enter key on my laptop is broken.
ex.zh: 我筆電的 Enter 鍵壞了。

key.en: one of the parts you press on a keyboard or piano

ex.en: That young man is very keen on cycling.
ex.zh: 那個年輕人非常熱衷騎腳踏車。

ex.en: She is keen to learn more about marketing.
ex.zh: 她很想多學一些行銷知識。

keen.en: very interested in or excited about something

ex.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺很靈敏。

ex.en: You have a keen sense of direction.
ex.zh: 你的方向感很好。

ex.en: A dog's sense of smell is much keener than a human's.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺比人類敏銳得多。

ex.en: There is keen competition for the job.
ex.zh: 這份工作競爭很激烈。

ex.en: Competition in the phone market is keen.
ex.zh: 手機市場競爭激烈。

keen.en: very strong, with people trying hard to win

ex.en: She watched the match keenly from the front row.
ex.zh: 她在前排專注地觀看比賽。

ex.en: He felt keenly the loss of his old friend.
ex.zh: 他深切感受到失去老朋友的痛苦。

keenly.en: in a very careful and interested way

ex.en: The CEO will give the keynote at the conference.
ex.zh: 執行長將在研討會上發表主題演講。

ex.en: The keynote speech starts at nine.
ex.zh: 主題演講九點開始。

keynote.en: the main speech at a meeting that sets out the main ideas

ex.en: My key card stopped working, so I went back to the front desk.
ex.zh: 我的房卡不能用了，所以我回到櫃檯。

ex.en: Insert your key card to turn on the lights.
ex.zh: 把房卡插進去就能開燈。

key card.en: a plastic card used to open the door of a hotel room

ex.en: The zoo keeper feeds the animals every morning.
ex.zh: 動物園管理員每天早上餵動物。

ex.en: The lighthouse keeper lived alone on the island.
ex.zh: 燈塔看守人獨自住在島上。

ex.en: The keeper made a great save in the last minute.
ex.zh: 守門員在最後一分鐘做了一次精彩的撲救。

ex.en: Our keeper is the tallest player on the team.
ex.zh: 我們的守門員是隊上最高的球員。

ex.en: Ken is bringing sandwiches to the picnic this weekend.
ex.zh: 肯這個週末會帶三明治來野餐。

ex.en: I asked Ken to help me carry the boxes upstairs.
ex.zh: 我請肯幫我把箱子搬上樓。

ex.en: That kind of advanced math is beyond my ken.
ex.zh: 那種高深的數學超出我的理解範圍。

ex.en: Most of the technical details were beyond the ken of ordinary readers.
ex.zh: 大部分技術細節超出了一般讀者的理解範圍。

ex.en: Keith teaches math at the local high school.
ex.zh: 基思在當地的高中教數學。

ex.en: Keith always arrives early for our meetings.
ex.zh: 基思總是提早到我們的會議。

ex.en: Kent is a county in the southeast of England.
ex.zh: 肯特郡是英格蘭東南部的一個郡。

ex.en: We drove through the green countryside of Kent.
ex.zh: 我們開車穿過肯特郡綠意盎然的鄉間。

ex.en: Kevin picked us up at the airport after the long flight.
ex.zh: 長途飛行後，凱文到機場接我們。

ex.en: I asked Kevin to help me move the sofa.
ex.zh: 我請凱文幫我搬沙發。

ex.en: Kelly runs three miles before work every morning.
ex.zh: 凱莉每天早上上班前都會跑三英里。

ex.en: Kelly sent me a postcard from Italy.
ex.zh: 凱莉從義大利寄了一張明信片給我。

ex.en: Kenneth is a name that comes from Scotland.
ex.zh: 肯尼斯這個名字源自蘇格蘭。

ex.en: The teacher asked Kenneth to hand out the papers.
ex.zh: 老師請肯尼斯發考卷。

ex.en: John F. Kennedy was the thirty-fifth president of the United States.
ex.zh: 約翰·甘迺迪是美國第三十五任總統。

ex.en: Kennedy is a surname with Irish roots.
ex.zh: 肯尼迪是個源自愛爾蘭的姓氏。

ex.en: Put the kettle on, and I will make some tea.
ex.zh: 把水壺放上去燒水，我來泡點茶。

ex.en: The kettle started to whistle when the water boiled.
ex.zh: 水一滾，水壺就開始嗚嗚作響。

ex.en: Kenya is a country in East Africa known for its wildlife.
ex.zh: 肯亞是東非的一個國家，以野生動物聞名。

ex.en: Many tourists travel to Kenya to see lions and elephants.
ex.zh: 許多遊客前往肯亞觀賞獅子和大象。

ex.en: Keynes was a British economist whose ideas shaped modern economics.
ex.zh: 凱因斯是英國經濟學家，他的理論影響了現代經濟學。

ex.en: Many students read the work of Keynes in their economics classes.
ex.zh: 許多學生在經濟學課堂上讀凱因斯的著作。

ex.en: Type a keyword into the search box to find articles.
ex.zh: 在搜尋框輸入關鍵字就能找到文章。

ex.en: Good resumes include keywords from the job description.
ex.zh: 好的履歷會包含職缺說明中的關鍵字。

ex.en: The dog slept in his kennel in the yard.
ex.zh: 那隻狗睡在院子裡的狗屋。

ex.en: We left our puppy at a kennel during the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行期間我們把小狗寄放在寵物旅館。

ex.en: They kennel their dogs when they travel.
ex.zh: 他們出門旅行時會把狗寄放在狗舍。

ex.en: We had to kennel the puppy overnight at the clinic.
ex.zh: 我們得讓小狗在診所的狗舍過夜。

ex.en: Some economists support a Keynesian approach to ending a recession.
ex.zh: 有些經濟學家支持用凱因斯式的方法來結束經濟衰退。

ex.en: The class discussed Keynesian theory this week.
ex.zh: 這週課堂討論了凱因斯理論。

ex.en: As a Keynesian, he believes the government should spend more in a downturn.
ex.zh: 身為凱因斯主義者，他認為不景氣時政府應該多支出。

ex.en: The Keynesians and their critics debated the new budget.
ex.zh: 凱因斯主義者與批評者針對新預算展開辯論。

ex.en: Each kernel of corn was golden and sweet.
ex.zh: 每一粒玉米都金黃又香甜。

ex.en: Crack the shell to get the kernel inside.
ex.zh: 敲開殼就能拿到裡面的果仁。

ex.en: There is a kernel of truth in what he said.
ex.zh: 他說的話裡有幾分真實。

ex.en: The kernel of the plan is to save time.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的核心就是節省時間。

ex.en: He put too much ketchup on his fries.
ex.zh: 他在薯條上擠了太多蕃茄醬。

ex.en: Please pass me the ketchup bottle.
ex.zh: 請把蕃茄醬瓶子遞給我。

ex.en: She stepped off the kerb without looking.
ex.zh: 她沒看路就走下了人行道邊。

ex.en: Please don't park too close to the kerb.
ex.zh: 請不要把車停得太靠近路緣。

ex.en: They used a kerosene lamp during the power outage.
ex.zh: 停電時他們點了煤油燈。

ex.en: The heater runs on kerosene.
ex.zh: 這台暖爐燒的是煤油。

keeping.zh: 保持；保留；繼續（keep 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is keeping her promise to visit every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她信守承諾，每個星期天都去探望。

ex.en: Keeping a diary helps me remember what happened each day.
ex.zh: 寫日記能幫我記住每天發生的事。

ex.en: The documents are in the lawyer's keeping.
ex.zh: 這些文件由律師保管。

ex.en: I left my cat in my sister's keeping while I traveled.
ex.zh: 我旅行期間把貓託給姊姊照顧。

ex.en: The Kenyan runner won the marathon in a great time.
ex.zh: 那位肯亞跑者以優異的成績贏得馬拉松。

ex.en: A Kenyan friend taught me a few words of Swahili.
ex.zh: 一位肯亞朋友教了我幾個史瓦希利語的單字。

ex.en: Kentucky is a state in the eastern United States.
ex.zh: 肯塔基州是美國東部的一個州。

ex.en: Horse racing is very popular in Kentucky.
ex.zh: 賽馬在肯塔基州非常受歡迎。

kew.zh: 邱園（倫敦的著名植物園）

ex.en: Kew Gardens in London is famous for its large collection of plants.
ex.zh: 倫敦的邱園以豐富的植物收藏聞名。

ex.en: We spent an afternoon walking around Kew.
ex.zh: 我們花了一個下午在邱園裡散步。

ex.en: We stayed in a small Kentish village last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天住在肯特郡的一個小村莊。

ex.en: The Kentish countryside is known for its apple orchards.
ex.zh: 肯特郡的鄉間以蘋果園聞名。

ex.en: They rolled a keg of beer into the garden for the party.
ex.zh: 他們把一桶啤酒推進花園辦派對。

ex.en: The old keg was filled with nails.
ex.zh: 那個舊木桶裡裝滿了釘子。

ex.en: A kestrel hovered above the field, looking for mice.
ex.zh: 一隻紅隼在田野上空盤旋，尋找老鼠。

ex.en: The kestrel is a small bird of prey.
ex.zh: 紅隼是一種小型猛禽。

ex.en: The keystone holds the arch together at the top.
ex.zh: 拱頂石讓拱門頂端緊緊固定在一起。

ex.en: Trust is the keystone of a good friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是良好友誼的基石。

ex.en: The keel keeps the sailboat steady in the wind.
ex.zh: 龍骨讓帆船在風中保持穩定。

ex.en: The ship's keel was made of strong oak.
ex.zh: 這艘船的龍骨是用堅固的橡木做的。

ex.en: The boat keeled over in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 小船在強風中翻覆了。

ex.en: He keeled over from the heat and fainted.
ex.zh: 他熱得倒下去昏倒了。

ex.en: Enter the code on the keypad to open the door.
ex.zh: 在數字鍵盤上輸入密碼就能開門。

ex.en: The phone's keypad lights up in the dark.
ex.zh: 這支手機的按鍵在黑暗中會發光。

ex.en: He peeked through the keyhole to see who was inside.
ex.zh: 他從鑰匙孔偷看裡面是誰。

ex.en: I couldn't fit the key into the keyhole in the dark.
ex.zh: 黑暗中我沒辦法把鑰匙插進鑰匙孔。

ex.en: He walks so fast that I can't keep up.
ex.zh: 他走得太快，我跟不上。

ex.en: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology.
ex.zh: 要跟上所有新科技很不容易。

ex.en: Keep up the good work, everyone!
ex.zh: 大家繼續保持好表現！

ex.en: She keeps up her exercise routine even when she travels.
ex.zh: 她連旅行時也持續維持運動習慣。

ex.en: The noisy neighbors kept me up all night.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的鄰居讓我整晚睡不著。

ex.en: The baby cried and kept up the whole family.
ex.zh: 寶寶一直哭，讓全家人都沒得睡。

ex.en: Let's keep in touch after you move to Taichung.
ex.zh: 你搬到台中之後，我們要保持聯絡喔。

ex.en: She kept in touch with her old classmates through social media.
ex.zh: 她透過社群媒體和老同學保持聯絡。

ex.en: It's hard to keep in touch when everyone is so busy.
ex.zh: 大家都這麼忙，很難保持聯絡。
